name: @nexus/trading-plan
description: Phase 10C-1 Production Actionable Decision Engine — pure, deterministic, fail-closed derivation of an actionable TradePlan (decision summary / action verdict, execution checklist, risk checklist, trade invalidation, readiness score) from an already-served TradingDecision (single source of truth) + live control/risk/DQ context. IO-free, clock-injected; recomputes NOTHING the TradingDecision already carries. Consumed by the web tier.
